rows.whatWasWrong: Two defects, both measured on this family's own committed bytes before anything moved. (1) All 112 requiredBeforeFiling disclosureLabel values were the printed caption WITH THE ACROFORM FIELD NAME APPENDED -- "SUPERIOR COURT DIVISION Division", "Description of Offense 7", "Other Expenses 57" -- while participant-instructions.md said twice that the column is the words printed beside the blank. The appended numbers correspond to nothing printed: 200-00130 prints its question-1 charge table as rows 1., 2. and 3. and the labels read 1, 4 and 7, and 200-00130 fields 26, 27, 30 and 31 each carry TWO widgets in two unrelated tables, so one identifier named two different blanks. (2) Underneath that, the 600-00228 page-1 expenses column was paired one row out from field 50 down: the blank beside the printed word Clothing was disclosed as "the unlabelled expense line printed left of Clothing", the blank beside Medical as Clothing, and so on to field 57, the blank beside Total Expenses, disclosed as "Other Expenses" with the what-to-write "any other monthly expense" -- on a declaration signed under penalty of perjury. Field 35 was named after a line 24pt above it and the Vehicles headings were split on the extraction rather than by x-position. (3) Separately, the six 600-00228 selection widgets delivered the court's own appearance with its leading opaque background fill stripped, so the printed ballot-box glyph was revealed AND the widget box stamped over it: two frames at every one of the six.
rows.whyThisWasNotJustCopiedFromTheSiblings: The three sibling families were repaired on the previous shift and their ids were already in both gated sets. This lane did NOT simply add two ids and rebuild. The 600-00228 captions were re-derived from geometry, independently, against the source THIS family binds: its source-receipt names 600-00228 at 263d4e196cbca1bfba14ec730368fcc897dd2bb667d6a43ade7f612d42541654 and those bytes were re-hashed from MASTER_LIBRARY_SOURCE_DIR before the derivation ran, so the geometry read is the geometry this family delivers and not a similarly named revision.
rows.howTheCaptionsWereReDerived: Each of the 42 page-1 and 38 page-2 AcroForm widget rectangles was read first-hand from the pinned binary. A printed blank was defined as a text run beginning with a "$" item and continuing over items that are only underscores, of at least five underscores -- a definition that had to be written twice, because the left income column encodes its marker as a single item "$__" and a naive test for an item whose whole text is "$" missed every one of them. A widget was paired with the run whose BASELINE falls inside its own rectangle and which overlaps it in x; a widget with no such run, or with more than one, was refused rather than guessed. The caption was then read from the printed items on baselines within 3.5pt of that run, lying in x between that run's own COLUMN start and the run's left edge, assembled in x order. The column start came from the page's two printed column headings by x-position -- "Your Current Monthly Income" at x=41.64 and "Your monthly household expenses" at x=320.40 -- and never from extraction order, which interleaves the two columns line by line and produced "Other Income $_____________ Fuel (heat and/or gas)" as one caption on the first attempt.
rows.whatTheReDerivationFound: It reproduces the committed corrections exactly and adds none. Expenses column, widget -> printed caption: 45 Rent or Mortgage Payment, 46 Electric Service, 47 Phone, 48 Fuel (heat and/or gas), 49 Food, 50 Clothing, 51 Medical, 52 Child Support, 53 Auto Loan Payment, 54 Property Taxes, 55 Insurance (health, auto, etc.), 56 Other Expenses, 57 Total Expenses. Income column: 27 Gross Income from Wages / Unemployment, 29 Compensation, 31 Child Support, 33 Other Income, 35 the italic SSDI line at baseline 137.80. Not one caption on this family's forms resolves differently from the equivalent on the three already repaired: all 112 finished disclosure labels are string-identical to vt_seal_felony-set's, 0 end in a bare field name and 0 are duplicated within a form and page.
rows.ambiguityLeftAsCommittedAndRecorded: MonthlyTotal and 41 were NOT moved, and the ambiguity is now measured rather than asserted. Two geometric rules disagree there and only there. By the widget's own vertical band the printed label at MonthlyTotal's height is "(other than wages)" (item baseline 103.642, inside its band 92.56..106.56) and at 41's height is "Total Monthly Income" (91.192, inside 79.91..93.91) -- one row above what the dictionary says. By the printed blank inside the widget, the run at 95.640 sits 4.448pt above "Total Monthly Income" and 8.002pt below "(other than wages)", and the run at 83.400 sits 4.448pt above "Total Income in the past 12 months" and 7.792pt below "Total Monthly Income" -- which agrees with the dictionary and with the widget's own name MonthlyTotal. Two of three signals support the committed pairing, so nothing was moved.
